name: com.com2usplatform.hiveaxyl.auth.addon.webauth
description: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 8252) external user-agent authentication addon for Hive Axyl SDK. Opens authorization URLs in the platform web auth session (iOS/macOS ASWebAuthenticationSession, Android Chrome Custom Tabs, Windows loopback HTTP, WebGL postMessage) and returns the raw redirect callback. OAuth interpretation (PKCE, state, nonce) and redirect-URI matching are the app's responsibility.
